fact: ONAGRI's note on the 2021-2022 cereal campaign assesses crop condition from FAO GIEWS satellite indicators (ASI, NDVI anomaly, VCI, VHI) up to January 2022, calling it an early-warning system based on satellite imagery, and finds the season going fairly well.
title: Analyse qualitative du déroulement de la campagne céréalière 2021-2022 en Tunisie
